messages:
incident-bot: Automated alert: p95 latency > 3x SLO for 5m in region us-west-2 (inference-api). Triggering page.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page fired to rotation `oncall-inference` — incident id PD-1758888123. Escalation policy: standard
maya: Acked the page, on my way. Looking at traces.
samir: I'm seeing a tail spike on long-context routes (seq > 2048). P95 -> 2.1s (SLO 600ms). Top traces show kv-cache misses + large batches.
devon: thanks. Triage plan: 1) reduce max batch size to 8 for prod hotpath 2) enable emergency routing -> dedicated pool for high-latency routes 3) prime KV cache for those models
jules: I can flip the routing policy. Doing a dry-run first.
maya: copy. I'll scale the serving runtime replicas while you flip routing.
maya: running:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-runtime --replicas=18
```
maya: scaled to 18, watch metrics
devon: routing change: `/api/v1/routes/priority-hotpatch` set weight: dedicated:80, hosted:20 — applying
jules: applied routing change, returning 80% traffic of long-tail routes to dedicated pool
samir: metrics: p95 dropping from 2.1s -> 1.0s within 90s. KV miss-rate still high for one model shard (model-v3-encoder-7b)
maya: priming KV cache for model-v3 shards (background warmup)
maya: `warmup-tool --model model-v3-encoder-7b --shard all --rate 50rps`
ops-lead: any customer-facing impact?
devon: customer impact scope: short-lived increase in latency for a subset of long-content inference (chat sessions > 2k tokens). No increased error rate, just latency. We already routed most traffic to dedicated, so impact is decreasing.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident PD-1758888123 acknowledged by maya
incident-bot: note: autoscaler had a 2m cooldown and didn't react to initial surge — we should revisit hysteresis
samir: warmup completed for 3/4 shards, p95 now ~620ms. still slightly above SLO for the heaviest routes but trending down
maya: dropping max batch size from 16 -> 8 for long-context routes to reduce tail
jules: confirmed config change pushed: `max_batch_size: 8` for route `long-context`.
devon: can we enable temporary caching of prefixes for chat sessions? small TTL, just to avoid repeated kv misses
maya: enabling prefix cache (TTL 2m) in prod for affected models
samir: graphs show p95 steady at ~580ms. p99 at 1.2s but falling. No new alerts in the last 3m.
ops-lead: good work. Please prepare a short incident summary and any follow-ups. Likely action items: revisit autoscaler cooldown, add shard warmup after deploys, and improve early routing for long-context.
maya: filing follow-up ticket and adding runbook note: `runbook/inference/long-context-autopage.md` with mitigation steps we used.
maya: handoff to morning shift in 45m — I'll leave notes in the ticket and mark incident as mitigated. If anything flares, ping PD again
devon: agreed. I'll open a quick postmortem draft and list config diffs.
jules: leaving logs/links: Grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/ai/1758888123 - traces: https://jaeger.internal/trace/1758888123
incident-bot: Incident PD-1758888123 — mitigation in place, monitoring. No active page.
maya: closing slack thread for now. Good job team :thumbsup:
